articles.title: US to hold trilateral talks with Ukraine, Russia in Abu Dhabi next week
articles.description: Delegations from Ukraine and Russia will meet in Abu Dhabi on November 10-11 for peace talks. The discussions seek to address ending the conflict, post-war security agreements, and humanitarian measures. American negotiators, including Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, will represent the U.S. Recent U.S.-mediated talks have aimed at finding a breakthrough before winter arrives. Both sides reportedly remain far apart in negotiating a potential peace deal.

articles.title: Russia bombs aid center and shelter in southern Ukraine, killing 26
articles.description: Russia's airstrikes targeted an aid distribution center and a shelter in southern Ukraine, resulting in significant casualties. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the attacks and warned of potential escalations. Emergency responders reported about 20 individuals missing as they searched the rubble for survivors. A limited ceasefire had recently expired, allowing for humanitarian missions in the region. Cyberattacks also disrupted emergency alerts in both Ukraine and Russia during this period.
